pairwise_evaluate_responses: run a pairwise evaluation of two model responses using a local VLM for image or reasoning tasks
parse_llm_json_output: parse JSON from LLM output that may be wrapped in markdown code blocks
create_local_pairwise_evaluator: create a LocalPairwiseEvaluator instance with a specified model name and optional device ID
create_qwen3vl8b_evaluator: create a Qwen3VL8BPairwiseEvaluator instance for pairwise evaluation using the Qwen3-VL-8B model
get_evaluator_name: get the evaluator name property that returns the model name with pairwise evaluator suffix
